name: io.github.clovis500c/figma-bridge
title: Figma Bridge
description: Let any AI agent design in the Figma desktop app: build, import websites, tokens, audits, code.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Figma personal access token, only for the comments and versions tools

environmentVariables.name: ROBLOX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Roblox Open Cloud API key (Assets API), only to upload export_roblox pictures

environmentVariables.name: ROBLOX_CREATOR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Roblox user id, or group:<id>, that owns uploaded pictures

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_BRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local port shared with the Figma plugin (default 3055)
